changes.reason: T&C: 5 reward points per Rs125 on air and e-catering.
Cap is on total air-ticket earning per cycle.
WP7: T&C: 5 RP per Rs125 on IRCTC Air (air.irctc.co.in). The website names did not resolve (rule was info); merchant IRCTC plus airline MCCs keeps rail tickets out.
WP7: The channel restated the IRCTC air website.

WP7: D28c: T&C booklet: "Reward Points reversed for Flexipay/Merchant EMI will be credited back ... only when the respective Flexipay/Merchant EMI has been successfully cancelled". The record's EMI row needs category emi AND rail emi, so an EMI purchase in another category earned. Rail-EMI exclusion on all spend.

Card-data: T&C 11.3(c)(iii): "Cardholder shall earn 1 Point for every eligible `125 charged ... All spending ... will be eligible to earn Points except the following" - the "eligible non-fuel retail" condition restates the card's exclusion rows (fuel MCCs 5172/5541/5542/5983, wallet, rent, government, EMI, cash advance), which all exist. It was an info earning rule; the base it states is the same 1 per Rs125 the loader synthesised.

Card-data: D14b. T&C 11.3(c)(ii): "3 reward Point for `125 spent on Dining and Standing Instruction on Utility Spends" - only a utility payment set up as a standing instruction earns 3; whether a utility spend is a standing instruction is not in the transaction context. Stays info; utility spends earn the 1 per Rs125 base (under-states).

Card-data: D14b. T&C "Value Back on Railway Ticket booking" (a) "upto 10% value back on 1st Class AC, 2nd Class AC, 3rd Class AC, Executive Chair Car and Chair Car" and (c) "You must be one of the passengers on the ticket" - travel class and passenger are not in the context, and the rate is "up to". Stays info; IRCTC rail tickets earn the base (under-states).
